sam: AP posted a credit memo from Zenith Labs (CM-2042) with no PO match; it routed to ENG-OPS approver. PDF in Concur: https://concur.company/receipts/CM-2042. @devin @lisa can you triage?

devin: pulling match logs now. any vendor PO on their email?

ProcureBot: Coupa: no exact PO match for CM-2042. Candidates: PO 87654 (closed), PO 88765 (open). Suggested: PO 88765 (needs manual confirm).

marta: AP shows posting to AP-Clearing with GL split. Holding final post until we confirm PO.

sam: snapshot of AP lines pasted below, holding: 
```csv
invoice,line,amount,gl
CM-2042,1,7000,6110-EngOps
CM-2042,2,3000,8005-CloudCosts
```

lisa: called Zenith. They confirm credit applies to PO 88765 and will resend corrected memo (original had a transposed digit). I can verify once it's in.

alex: if 88765 is correct we rematch and fix approver routing to Vendor Relations. I'll propose an automation to flag credits referencing closed POs.

devin: opened ticket FIN-915 to track rematch + routing tweak. ProcureBot, attempt re-association and attach FIN-915.

ProcureBot: Rematch queued. PO 88765 matched to CM-2042 (supplier ZEN-001). FIN-915 updated. Status: pending AP finalize.

sam: applied credit at 1782345939 -> moved from AP Clearing to PO 88765, kept GL split. Marking FIN-915 resolved.

marta: thanks all. alex please post RFC for closed-PO credit detection. Closing thread.
